messages:
Asha (PM): kicking off cross-team milestone map for Q3 planning. Need to lock critical path by EOD Fri. main unknowns: infra capacity, model quantization window, and e2e QA time.
Tom (Eng Manager): noted. can we get a hard list of deps per milestone? I'll align eng capacity.
Priya (SRE): infra capacity depends on Dedicated pools decision — if we commit to Dedicated by 5/1 we need node procurement timeline.
Jae (Infra): procurement ETA 6 weeks from PO. alternative: burst on hosted while we ramp an on-prem flavor.
Carlos (Data): model quantization requires refactor of the tokenizer pipeline; estimate 2 sprints.
Asha (PM): okay, propose splitting rollout into: alpha feature flag -> limited customers -> GA. critical path likely quant + infra + e2e. agree?
Tom (Eng Manager): agree. reorder tasks: quant work (sprint1) -> infra prep (sprint2 overlapping) -> e2e (sprint3).
Priya (SRE): can we overlap infra prep with quant? we need baseline perf tests. if quant blocks, infra sits idle.
Jae (Infra): suggest a staged perf contract: perf harness ready week 2, initial bench week 3.
Asha (PM): put together a simple matrix here. @Tom @Jae @Carlos assign owners.
Tom (Eng Manager): I'll own quant implementation and bench automation. short action: create RFC and link.
Tom (Eng Manager): RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/quantization-path — contains perf target table.
Carlos (Data): I'll own tokenizer refactor. will add checklist in doc.
Priya (SRE): I'll own perf harness and can provide capacity forecast.
Asha (PM): Great. Draft milestones:
- M1: Quant baseline + tokenizer refactor (owner: Tom/Carlos) target: week 4
- M2: Perf harness + infra config (owner: Priya/Jae) target: week 6
- M3: Alpha rollout (owner: Asha/Tom) target: week 8
Asha (PM): Critical blockers: procurement lag (>4w) and cross-team QA availability. we need mitigation.
Jae (Infra): Mitigation: host-burst plan and mock KV cache to speed integration tests.
Tom (Eng Manager): mitigation for QA: reserve 2 Sprints of dedicated QA FTE or shift non-critical tests post-GA.
Asha (PM): Risk table quick:
- Procurement delay -> impact: infra target slip 4-6w -> mitigation: host burst
- Quant regression -> impact: perf/TX drop -> mitigation: canary on small model, rollback policy
- QA bandwidth -> impact: release quality -> mitigation: reduce scope for alpha (disable non-core features)
Carlos (Data): Is there a customer commitment date for this? Sales asked for July 15 for pilot.
Asha (PM): yes sales requested July 15. With current estimates GA by late Aug. need to surface to GTM.
Tom (Eng Manager): action items:
- Tom: draft RFC + assign tickets (done by Tue)
- Carlos: tokenizer PR plan (end of week)
- Priya: capacity forecast + perf harness skeleton (Thu)
- Jae: procurement route and host-burst runbook (Thu)
- Asha: sync with sales and update roadmap slide (Fri)
LaunchBot: Reminder: Add milestone 'Alpha rollout' to roadmap calendar on 1912347600.
Asha (PM): I'll run a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize owners. if anyone can't make, DM me.
Priya (SRE): I'll be on. Tom out Tue morning but ok for afternoon.
Carlos (Data): on board.
Jae (Infra): noted.
Tom (Eng Manager): thanks—will post RFC link in this thread when ready :thumbsup: 
Asha (PM): Thanks team. closing thread for now, will re-open after RFC. :white_check_mark:
